hints.title: Sorted Frequency Property
hints.text: Since elements appear in sorted order, all occurrences of the target appear consecutively as a single continuous block.

hints.title: Locate Leftmost Position
hints.text: Find the first index where target appears. If target exists, its rightmost instance must extend past index first plus n // 2.

hints.title: Direct Index Check
hints.text: Let idx be the first index of target. If idx plus n // 2 is within bounds and the element at that position equals target, return true; else return false.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
import bisect

class Solution:
    def isMajorityElement(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> bool:
        n = len(nums)
        idx = bisect.bisect_left(nums, target)
        return idx + n // 2 < n and nums[idx + n // 2] == target
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning counts all elements in O(N) time without exploiting the sorted array guarantee.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Finding the first occurrence logarithmically followed by an O(1) stride check runs in logarithmic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should avoid full linear scans and implement the logarithmic first-occurrence leap.
complexity.notes: Majority requires strictly more than half of all elements.
